. capture label variable AIRPOLLUTION1        "Air-pollution PC1"

. capture label define highlow 0 "Below/equal median" 1 "Above median", replace

.
. local biomarkers_cat ""

. foreach v of local biomarkers_cont
  2.     capture confirm variable `v'
  3.     if !_rc
  4.         capture confirm variable cat_`v'
  5.         if _rc
  6.             quietly summarize `v' if sample_final==1, detail
  7.             scalar med_`v' = r(p50)
  8.             gen byte cat_`v' = (`v' > med_`v') if sample_final==1 & !missing(`v')
  9.             label values cat_`v' highlow
 10.             local vlab : variable label `v'
 11.             if "`vlab'"=="" local vlab "`v'"
 12.             label variable cat_`v' "`vlab', above vs. below/equal median"
 13.
 14.         local biomarkers_cat "`biomarkers_cat' cat_`v'"
 15.
 16.

.
. local pollutants_cat ""

. foreach v of local pollutants_cont
  2.     capture confirm variable `v'
  3.     if !_rc
  4.         capture confirm variable cat_`v'
  5.         if _rc
  6.             quietly summarize `v' if sample_final==1, detail
  7.             scalar med_`v' = r(p50)
  8.             gen byte cat_`v' = (`v' > med_`v') if sample_final==1 & !missing(`v')
  9.             label values cat_`v' highlow
 10.             local vlab : variable label `v'

 12.             label variable cat_`v' "`vlab', above vs. below/equal median"

  7.     else

. ********************************************************************************
. * 2. Helper program for Benjamini-Hochberg q-values
. ********************************************************************************
.
. capture program drop make_bh_q

. program define make_bh_q
  1.     syntax varname, PVAR(name) QVAR(name)
  2.
.     tempvar obsid rank m rawq
  3.
.     capture drop `qvar'
  4.     gen long `obsid' = _n
  5.
.     preserve
  6.         keep `obsid' `varlist' `pvar'
  7.         keep if !missing(`pvar') & !missing(`varlist')
  8.
.         sort `varlist' `pvar' `obsid'
  9.         by `varlist': gen long `rank' = _n
 10.         by `varlist': gen long `m' = _N
 11.         gen double `rawq' = `pvar' * `m' / `rank'
 12.
.         gsort `varlist' -`rank'
 13.         gen double `qvar' = .
 14.         by `varlist': replace `qvar' = `rawq' if _n == 1
 15.         by `varlist': replace `qvar' = min(`rawq', `qvar'[_n-1]) if _n > 1
 16.         replace `qvar' = min(`qvar', 1)
 17.
.         keep `obsid' `qvar'
 18.         tempfile qtmp
 19.         save "`qtmp'", replace
 20.     restore
 21.
.     merge 1:1 `obsid' using "`qtmp'", nogen
 22.     drop `obsid'
 23. end

.
. ********************************************************************************
. * 3. Helper program to post categorical/continuous interaction results
. ********************************************************************************
.
. capture program drop post_interaction_model

. program define post_interaction_model
  1.     syntax, HANDLE(name) ANALYSISTYPE(string) XVAR(name) ZVAR(name) ///
>         XTYPE(string) ZTYPE(string) TRANSition(integer) MODEL(string) COVARS(string)
  2.
.     local trlabel = cond(`transition'==1, "Healthy->PD", ///
>                     cond(`transition'==2, "Healthy->Dementia", "Healthy->Death"))
  3.
.     local xlab : variable label `xvar'
  4.     if "`xlab'"=="" local xlab "`xvar'"
  5.
.     local zlab : variable label `zvar'
  6.     if "`zlab'"=="" local zlab "`zvar'"
  7.
.     if "`xtype'"=="binary" & "`ztype'"=="binary"
  8.         local modelterm i.`xvar'##i.`zvar'
  9.         local intterm 1.`xvar'#1.`zvar'
 10.
 11.     else if "`xtype'"=="continuous" & "`ztype'"=="binary"
 12.         local modelterm c.`xvar'##i.`zvar'
 13.         local intterm c.`xvar'#1.`zvar'
 14.
 15.     else if "`xtype'"=="binary" & "`ztype'"=="continuous"
 16.         local modelterm i.`xvar'##c.`zvar'
 17.         local intterm 1.`xvar'#c.`zvar'
 18.
 19.     else
 20.         local modelterm c.`xvar'##c.`zvar'
 21.         local intterm c.`xvar'#c.`zvar'
 22.
 23.
.     capture noisily streg `modelterm' `covars' ///
>         if sample_final==1 & _trans`transition'==1, distribution(weibull) nohr
 24.
.     if !_rc
 25.         capture scalar bint = _b[`intterm']
 26.         if _rc exit
 27.
.         scalar seint = _se[`intterm']
 28.         scalar zstat = bint/seint
 29.         scalar pint  = 2*normal(-abs(zstat))
 30.         scalar hrint = exp(bint)
 31.         scalar lci   = exp(bint - invnormal(0.975)*seint)
 32.         scalar uci   = exp(bint + invnormal(0.975)*seint)
 33.
.         scalar Nmodel = e(N)
 34.         capture scalar Kmodel = e(k)
 35.         if _rc scalar Kmodel = e(rank)
 36.         scalar AICm = -2*e(ll) + 2*Kmodel
 37.         scalar BICm = -2*e(ll) + ln(e(N))*Kmodel
 38.
.         capture scalar Emodel = e(N_fail)
 39.         if _rc
 40.             quietly count if e(sample) & _d==1
 41.             scalar Emodel = r(N)
 42.
 43.
.         scalar jointHR  = .
 44.         scalar jointLCI = .
 45.         scalar jointUCI = .
 46.         scalar jointP   = .
 47.
.         if "`xtype'"=="binary" & "`ztype'"=="binary"
 48.             capture noisily lincom 1.`xvar' + 1.`zvar' + 1.`xvar'#1.`zvar'
 49.             if !_rc
 50.                 scalar jointHR  = exp(r(estimate))
 51.                 scalar jointLCI = exp(r(lb))
 52.                 scalar jointUCI = exp(r(ub))
 53.                 scalar jointP   = r(p)
 54.
 55.
 56.
.         post `handle' ///
>             ("`analysistype'") ///
>             ("`xvar'") ("`xlab'") ("`xtype'") ///
>             ("`zvar'") ("`zlab'") ("`ztype'") ///
>             (`transition') ("`trlabel'") ("`model'") ///
>             (Nmodel) (Emodel) ///
>             (bint) (seint) (hrint) (lci) (uci) (pint) ///
>             (jointHR) (jointLCI) (jointUCI) (jointP) ///
>             (AICm) (BICm)
 57.
 58. end
